summary: Line discount fix verified end-to-end at 390x844 as owner@tredi.app. New invoice -> customer Adeola Stores -> 2 inventory items (Adeba Rice 50kg at 62,000 and Alibaba rice at 500). New lines default to the % toggle. Line editor: set % to 7 -> 'Update line — ₦57,660' -> after Update, the inline DISC box shows 7 %, the card shows 62,000 struck through and ₦57,660 (93% of gross), and items-after-discount = ₦58,160 (57,660 + 500). Inline DISC on line 2: typed 10 -> 10 %, line ₦450, After discount ₦58,110. Value kept after blur, and reopening the editor shows 7. Review: gross 62,500, discount -4,390, subtotal 58,110, VAT 4,358, total 62,468. Saved as draft. The detail page shows the line discounts (-4,340 and -50) and total 62,468. Reopening with /invoices/new?edit=<id> shows the DISC boxes at 7 % and 10 % and After discount ₦58,110. The draft was deleted through the UI (invoice-kill -> kill-confirm) and the API then returned 404. setup-business: checked in the source only (demo useState(false) bound to Switch testID biz-demo-data). The screen was not opened because the owner account already has a business.

ui_bugs.issue: Deleting a draft calls router.back(). If the invoice was opened by deep link (no history), the user stays on the page of the invoice that was just deleted. Use router.replace('/sales') or a similar fallback when router.canGoBack() is false. Reference: /app/frontend/app/invoices/[id].tsx:74

In edit mode (?edit=<id>) the item cards lose the stock tags ('1499 in stock' / 'Only 0 in stock' amber warning) because stock and track are not filled in from the items list when the lines load. Reference: /app/frontend/app/invoices/new.tsx:157

issues: Two 'Confirm & issue' buttons are visible together: one inside the draft card and one next to 'Record payment'. Remove one.

action_items: Optional: after deleting a draft, fall back to router.replace when there is no back history
Optional: restore stock/track on lines when editing an existing invoice
Optional: remove the duplicate 'Confirm & issue' button on the draft detail page
critical_code_review_comments: LineDiscount is now controlled by line.discount_value, uses a draft only while focused, and clears it on blur. This is correct.
addItem and QuickAdd default discount_type to 'percent'. Loading an existing invoice still falls back to 'amount' when the type is missing (lines 157 and 171). That is fine for old data.
new.tsx is 784 lines, over the 700-line guideline. Consider moving LineDiscount, LineEditor and QuickAdd into their own component files.
seed_data_creation: One draft invoice for Adeola Stores (id 6aeed8cb887bfdf27ae63296) was created and then deleted through the UI. Confirmed 404.
